key_points: $25B share repurchase authorized (no termination date) plus dividend increase signals strong capital return commitment
Stock sold off ~14-16% on Nov 5 amid broad semiconductor rout driven by post-midterm fears of slower AI data-center spending
Premarket rebound on Nov 6 suggests buyback news providing near-term support
Buyback size (~20%+ of market cap) offers substantial downside cushion but does not resolve macro AI capex uncertainty
Fundamental outlook hinges on whether AI infrastructure spending decelerates; monitor upcoming equipment peer earnings and customer commentary
